notes:
Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter and Zaiqa Kitchen apps, version 2.23.0.

New: Online ordering website (Admin app)
• Your own order website for Kot Sultan: live menu from the POS, hot selling, sold-out items marked live, delivery, pick up and dine-in
• Every website order appears in the new Online Orders section. Press Accept and it goes to the printer and the Kitchen app like any other order. Reject with a reason
• Customers track their order live: confirmed, cooking, ready, on the way. Rider details are shown only when you approve them. Customers tap "I received my order"
• Free delivery over Rs 600 and area charges are set by you in Website Settings, along with hours, rewards and the Google review link
• Security check at checkout stops fake orders. Blocked numbers list included
• Website editor: a password-protected link to change wording, photos, offers and reviews
